name: TeamStarWolf - SmarterTools SmarterMail Exploitation and Ransomware, 2026 (CVE-2026-23760, CVE-2026-24423, CVE-2025-52691) Case Study
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. Enterprise ATT&CK v20.0 techniques bound in the case study of the 2026 exploitation of SmarterTools SmarterMail through CVE-2026-23760 (password-reset bypass), CVE-2026-24423 (ConnectToHub command execution) and CVE-2025-52691 (file upload), all three in KEV with ransomware use Known, and the vendor's own breach of 29 January 2026. No source lists ATT&CK ids; every binding is the study's own. Score 75: the CVE, NVD, KEV or CISA record describes the behavior. Score 50: a vendor, research or news report. Score 25: an inexact fit. Comments carry the study's source numbers.

techniques.comment: Probes for CVE-2026-24423 against ReliaQuest's victim (ReliaQuest, 9 Feb 2026) and one source IP scanning for SmarterMail on F5 Labs sensors from 17 Feb 2026 (F5 Labs, 12 Mar 2026). Sources: [20] [21].
Inexact fit: a reported attack two days after the Build 9511 fix, read as patch diffing by this study, not by a source (watchTowr Labs, 22 Jan 2026). Sources: [15].
PoC material for the SmarterMail flaws traded in Telegram channels (Flare, 18 Feb 2026). Sources: [25].
Inexact fit: the payload was hosted on a legitimate cloud platform, earlier on GitHub; the source does not say who uploaded it (ReliaQuest, 9 Feb 2026). Sources: [20].

Exploitation of the internet-facing SmarterMail server through CVE-2026-23760, CVE-2026-24423 and CVE-2025-52691 (CVE and NVD records, 22 and 23 Jan 2026; KEV, 26 Jan and 5 Feb 2026; vendor breach post, 3 Feb 2026). Sources: [5] [7] [9] [14] [15] [18] [20] [21].

Operating system command execution through built-in management functions and the ConnectToHub flaw (CVE records, 22 and 23 Jan 2026); System Events and a volume-mount feature used to run commands (Huntress, 22 Jan; ReliaQuest, 9 Feb 2026). Sources: [4] [6] [18] [20].
Forced reset of the system administrator password without the old password or a reset token (CVE-2026-23760 record, 22 Jan 2026). Sources: [4] [15] [18].
Forced reset of the system administrator password without the old password or a reset token (CVE-2026-23760 record, 22 Jan 2026). Sources: [4] [15] [18].
Attackers aimed to take Active Directory and create users (SmarterTools breach post, 3 Feb 2026). Sources: [14].
The legitimate Windows installer pulled the payload (ReliaQuest, 9 Feb 2026). Sources: [20].
The attacker removed the System Event and test domain it had created (Huntress, 22 Jan 2026). Sources: [18].
Payload downloaded from a cloud platform, earlier from GitHub (ReliaQuest, 9 Feb 2026). Sources: [20].
Velociraptor configured for command and control (ReliaQuest, 9 Feb 2026); Velociraptor, SimpleHelp and JWRapper named by the vendor in its breach (3 Feb 2026). Sources: [14] [20].
Encryption attempted and stopped at the vendor on 29 Jan 2026 (breach post, 3 Feb 2026); KEV ransomware use Known for all three CVEs (5 Feb, 26 Feb and 21 Apr 2026). Sources: [9] [10] [14].
